status: Verified first Greek environment and gate-puzzle sample. Full castle rollout is pending user review.

Two resting weights open both leaves; held weight cannot cheat; both nav grids and physics refresh
Puzzle weights survive charged grab, high-speed impact and damage; falling weight recovers; gate stays open
Wizard walks through the opened gate without an invisible collider

Trajectory snapshot removes the open door and includes parked leaves
